top_choice_rationale: P004 recognizes a unified theoretical achievement: defect-mediated melting provides a clear mechanism for how order is lost, while the hexatic phase makes a distinctive prediction whose explanatory value has endured. Its citation can stay focused on two-dimensional melting, although the historical division of credit among the proposed laureates merits review.
